f631ee6ec-a66a-44ca-9ccf-94e40e5b25c4.reason: bookseller's label pasted inside a book (a document/product), not a street sign

fc7b7084e-a21d-4497-9538-2b55bb123baf.notes: Yellow-on-black projecting box sign of a hairdresser, Madrid; written without the accent (PELUQUERIA). The side face repeats it vertically; a small graffiti sticker at lower right is a distractor.

k1003130046.notes: Tall vertical blade sign with gold letters on dark blue, stacked letter by letter, three stars at the bottom; pedestrian street leading to Puerta del Sol (Casa de Correos clock tower in the background). Distractors: 'BURGER KING' signs, a green pharmacy cross showing '12H', IKKS/UNO/'Iris' shop signs at right. Crowd is face-blurred and incidental.

k1020761130.notes: Multicoloured letters on a white window panel of a shoe shop at the right of the frame, between pop-art shoe panels; small and seen through a dirty windscreen. The vertical 'HOTEL EMPERADOR' blade at far left is cut ('...TEL EMPERADOR'), and Lion King / Preventiva signs are distractors.

k1020969730.notes: Red fascia panel with yellow letters and a small flower motif, over a striped awning; image washed out by sun glare. Generic name only (no pharmacy name). A faded plaza name plate on the corner wall above is illegible; an unlit green cross is at left.

k1020970562.reason: strongly motion-blurred shoe-brand window banner (advert); text not reliable

k1184782029.reason: night photo of Pride lamp-post banners and a kiosk with posters (slogans/adverts); traffic plate unreadable

k1957106937.notes: Black fascia board with white letters along a narrow street, at an oblique angle. Distractors: a projecting 'Casa Parrondo / Restaurante' sign with the Asturian flag further down, and vertical Japanese text 日本料理専門店 on the next facade. Pedestrians are face-blurred and incidental.

k1957107417.reason: shop signs are cut by the frame (CIBER LOC...) or small; no single clear target

k2027068841.notes: White letters on the valance of a red awning at top right, steep angle and motion blur. The blue 'ATM-Cajero' machine and a MoneyGram sign at left are distractors.

p9846a3e6e4.notes: Black arched fascia over a glass entrance, frontal and sharp; the name repeats on the window and door. Wall-mounted menu, alarm-company sticker and house number '1' in a circle are distractors.

pa36f42ac81.notes: Orange channel letters above a doorway on a granite facade; a red neon circular 'TIERRA' sign in the right window and an A-board menu repeat it. Cables and shadows cross the wall.

c139827395.notes: Espolla: two tile street plates on a rubble-stone wall. Upper newer Catalan plate (green border, municipal crest) in a decorative modernista font where the I of VILARS is drawn with a dot above (a letterform, not an accent; transcribed as plain I). Lower older Spanish plate 'CALLE DEL VILARS' with heavily cracked tiles. No accents on either.

c94562453.reason: ceramic no-parking sign with 'A tota la plaça' (in the whole square); names no specific place

c99470647.reason: petrol-station advertising panel ('Qualitat i preu / Calidad y precio / Autoservici 24h') with card logos; pure advert, no station name

c11320214.notes: Beige Junta de Andalucía site board on wooden posts in front of the Rules dam (Granada province). 'JUNTA DE ANDALUCIA' runs vertically (bottom-to-top) in a green side band, small, written without an accent on the sign; the main name is large black bold text. Visitors on the dam crest are tiny and incidental.

c149491787.notes: Spanish town-entry sign (white with red border) under a 50 km/h speed-limit roundel, beside a country road with the village and Sierra de Guadarrama behind (Segovia province). Small warning triangle and crossing sign down the road are distractors.

c21010046.notes: Segovia azulejo street plate set into an ochre wall: large gold patriarchal cross on top; the name below in black serif caps with 'DEL' smaller at the end of the first line, and the base of the cross overlapping 'ZA' of PLAZA.
